```{r setup, include = F, message = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

### Libraries

```{r loading_libraries, message = F}
# loading tidyverse library
library(tidyverse)

# loading p8105.datasets library
library(p8105.datasets)

# loading plotly library
library(plotly)
```

### Data

```{r loading_tidying data, message = F}
# loading ny_noaa data set
data(ny_noaa)

# tidying the ny_noaa data set
ny_noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  separate(
    date,
    into = c("year", "month", "day"),
    sep = "-"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, tmin),
      ~ na_if(as.numeric(.x), -9999)
    ),
    tmax = tmax / 10,
    tmin = tmin / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10
  )
```

### Scatter Plot

```{r creating_scatterplot, message = F}
# creating a daily maximum vs. minimum temperature ny scatter plot
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(
    year == "2010",
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = tmax)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    color = "black",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Maximum vs. Minimum Temperatures in New York (2010)", 
    x = "Minimum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Maximum Temperature"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Line Plot

```{r creating_lineplot, message = F}
# creating a line plot comparing max and min temperature trends in ny
ny_noaa_df |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_tmax, mean_tmin),
    names_to = "temperature",
    values_to = "mean_temp"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = as.numeric(year),
    y = mean_temp,
    color = temperature
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(
    option = "D",
    labels = c("Maximum temperature", "Minimum temperature")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Temperature Trends in New York (1981–2010)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Temperature"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Box Plot

```{r creating_boxplot, message = F}
# creating a monthly total precipitation per month across years in ny box plot
ny_noaa_df |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarize(
    total_prcp = sum(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      month,
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
      labels = month.abb
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = total_prcp, fill = month)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Total Precipitation Distribution in New York (1981-2010)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total Monthly Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
